display.purpose: Brand mark (WG) and login title only — never content headings.

body.purpose: All operational UI: body, labels, buttons, tables, headings.

shadows.name: shadow-1
shadows.purpose: Resting lift — stat cards, primary button at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-2
shadows.purpose: Hover response — primary button hover, elevated cards, popovers.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.value: 0.22s easeOut, opacity 0→1 + y 16→0 (getVariants zeroes under reduced motion)
motion.purpose: Per-page main content updates via shared pageVariants; initial={false} — SSR first paint renders immediately with no entrance animation (LCP).

motion.name: modal-pop
motion.value: 0.18s easeOut, opacity 0→1 + scale 0.96→1 (scale dropped under reduced motion)

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: Tailwind-only press feedback on interactive elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Wedding Gold action voice — one per view; shadow lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent-primary); color: var(--text-inverse); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); transition: all 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-primary-hover); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral surfaced action; steps one surface up on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet toolbar/icon action; gains a surface wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Solid red, confirm-delete dialogs only — never a row-level trigger.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-danger); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Button
components.description: Gold underlined text button for inline text actions (e.g. "Lihat di daftar →" inside alerts); auto-height, keeps the gold focus ring.
components.css: .ds-btn-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: auto; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--accent-primary); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; transition: color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-link:hover { color: var(--accent-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Surface-3 field, 36px; focus = strong border + gold ring; error = danger border.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--border-strong); }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Surface-4 dialog, 16px radius, shadow-modal over blurred 80% overlay.
components.html:
Tambah Tamu
Isi data tamu di bawah ini.
components.css: .ds-modal { max-width: 448px; width: 100%; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-4); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-modal); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-modal-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-cream); } .ds-modal-desc { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); }

components.name: Party Badge
components.description: Identity-coded party chip: color dot + subtle identity bg + contrast-safe text.
components.css: .ds-badge-party { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(201, 168, 76, 0.15); color: #d4b565; font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--chart-1); }

components.name: Group Badge
components.description: Group chip colored via colorForGroup(name): identity dot, dot at 15% alpha background, lightened contrast-safe text — applied inline (dynamic arbitrary classes are invisible to Tailwind's JIT). Values shown for Rekan Kerja.
components.css: .ds-badge-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #5B8CDB26; color: #A5C0EB; font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #5B8CDB; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Flat card with 3px left identity accent bar; tabular cream value.
components.css: .ds-stat { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-3); box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-bar { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 3px; background: var(--chart-1); } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-stat-value { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--accent-cream); }

components.name: Nav Rail
components.description: Desktop (lg+) 72px icon rail; active = gold on gold-subtle wash; logout pinned bottom. Below lg this is replaced by the Bottom Nav.
components.html: WG
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 72px; padding: 16px 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface-1); } .ds-rail-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--accent-primary); font-family: var(--font-display), Georgia, serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); transition: all 150ms; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-secondary); } .ds-rail-active, .ds-rail-active:hover { background: var(--accent-primary-subtle); color: var(--accent-primary); }

components.name: Bottom Nav
components.description: Mobile-only (<lg) fixed bottom bar, 56px: 3 routes + logout button, 44x44 targets, gold active with 4px dot, 10px labels, active:scale-90 press.
components.html: TamuKategori
components.css: .ds-bnav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface-1); } .ds-bnav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; width: 44px; height: 44px; color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 100ms; } .ds-bnav-item:active { transform: scale(0.9); } .ds-bnav-active { color: var(--accent-primary); } .ds-bnav-label { font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-bnav-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent-primary); } .ds-bnav-dot-off { background: transparent; }

components.name: Sticky Action Bar
components.description: Mobile-only (<sm) bar pinned directly above the bottom nav (bottom: 56px) holding Export CSV + Tambah Tamu; sm+ shows these actions in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-actionbar { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-actionbar-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent-primary); color: var(--text-inverse); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--shadow-1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-actionbar-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-body), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview: A single-admin operational tool that borrows Discord's spatial discipline and wraps it in wedding warmth. The structure is pure utility — a fixed icon rail, a sticky top bar, dense tables — but the color identity is gold, rose, and cream, not corporate blue. Dark is the only theme, hard-coded with no toggle. Density is tuned for manual data entry: compact rows, hover-reveal actions, keyboard-friendly forms, and a fast return to the list after every save. Expression lives in the accents; the working surfaces stay quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-by-default, permanently; no theme switcher anywhere
Discord spatial hierarchy: 72px icon rail + sticky 48px top bar + content surface
Gold/rose/cream accent layer on a five-step neutral surface scale
Admin-optimized density: compact tables, hover-reveal row actions, one primary action per view
Fraunces reserved for the brand mark only; Figtree does all the work

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Wedding Gold is the only color that ever means "act" — one primary action per view. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: Party color is always resolved through colorFor(name); group color through colorForGroup(name). A category means the same color on every page, forever — never rank, never order, never inline hex.

rules.name: The Brand-Only Display Rule
rules.body: Fraunces appears only in the brand mark and login title. Page headings, card titles, and content are always Figtree medium/semibold — never display type in content.

rules.name: The State-Responsive Elevation Rule
rules.body: Elevation increases only in response to state. Body and resting content carry no shadow; cards hold shadow-1/shadow-2; hover may step up one level; modals alone use shadow-modal.

dos: Do use CSS variables / Tailwind token classes for every color — never raw hex in components (the one sanctioned exception: party-colors.ts badge hexes).
Do resolve every party color through party-colors.ts colorFor(name) and every group color through colorForGroup(name) — badges, dots, stat accents, chart slices, all of them.
Do always use colorForGroup() for group color resolution — never inline group hex values.
Do keep table row actions on the hover-reveal pattern (opacity transition, always visible to keyboard focus-within and touch).
Do keep one Wedding Gold primary action per view; subordinate actions go secondary or ghost.
Do reserve solid Danger red for confirmation dialogs; row-level delete triggers are ghost danger icons.
Do give every async surface a loading state with reserved space (skeleton or spinner, no layout jump).
donts: Don't use Fraunces anywhere but the brand mark and login title — content headings are Figtree, always.
Don't add light mode, a theme toggle, or system-preference fallback without an explicit product decision; dark is the product.
Don't introduce a fourth accent color; the wedding layer is gold, rose, cream — semantics (danger/success/warning) are states, not accents.
Don't inline party or group hex values anywhere; identity comes from colorFor or nothing.
Don't style buttons, inputs, or modals page-locally; extend src/components/ui/ instead.
Don't use Muted Text for data-bearing content (counts, values, names) — it is for placeholders and hints, and sits near the contrast floor.
